==================
items: visibility and declarations

pub struct Stack[T] { items: list[T] }

pub enum Choice[T] {
    One(T),
    Two,
}

pub const LIMIT: int = 10

pub fn make() -> Stack[int] { Stack { items: [] } }

fn private_helper() -> int { LIMIT }

==================
items: impl blocks with associated functions and methods
==================

struct Stack[T] { items: list[T] }

impl[T] Stack[T] {
    pub fn new() -> Stack[T] { Stack { items: [] } }

    pub fn push(mut self, x: T) {
        self.items.push(x)
    }

    fn peek(self) -> T? {
        self.items.last()
    }
}

==================
items: tests and handlers
==================

fn add(a: int, b: int) -> int { a + b }

test "adds numbers" {
    assert(add(2, 3) == 5, "2 + 3 should be 5")
}

on init(settings: int) -> int { settings }

on shutdown() {}

on saved(doc: int) -> int { doc }
